observation.visible_scene: A dance-studio interior: white side walls, a pale wood floor, a dark ceiling with rows of track spotlights, a wall-mounted air-conditioner, sheer white curtains, and a large mirrored wall occupying the right of the frame. A woman with a long dark ponytail, in a black sleeveless top, a short black pleated skirt with a studded chain belt, and black knee-high boots, stands with her back to the camera, angled toward the mirror; a front-facing image of her appears in the mirror as a reflection (not a second person). The camera framing is fixed throughout.
visible_changes: t≈0.0–0.27 s: she holds both hands raised near her face/shoulders with elbows bent, making only small adjustments; the pose is largely sustained.
t≈0.30–0.37 s: her hands draw together in front of her neck/chest.
t≈0.40–0.70 s: her arms cross over her torso while she lifts the leg nearer the mirror, knee bent and boot raised off the floor; the lifted-leg posture is held with slight foot movement.
t≈0.73–0.87 s: the raised leg returns to the floor, her stance widens, and her arms stay crossed near the chest/neck.

t≈0.90–1.33 s: the arm on the mirror-side gradually extends outward to the side with an open hand while the other hand remains near her neck; her legs spread further and her hips/torso shift slightly.
The mirror reproduces each pose as a front-facing reflection in sync with her back-facing movements.
outside_clip_unknowns: The clip is a temporal crop: the dance is already in progress at the start and continues past the end, so the onset of the leg-lift and the outcome after t≈1.33 s are not shown.
No trigger or cause for any gesture is visible.
uncertain_details: Exact hand shapes (fist vs. open) in the early frames are small and hard to resolve.
Whether subtle weight shifts or foot repositioning occur is not clearly determinable.
The camera appears static; minor framing drift cannot be fully excluded.
